abstract: It has recently been discovered that cell-cycle gene transcription is regulated by a core complex named LINC that switches from a transcriptionally repressive complex in G(0)-G(1) with the p130 or p107 pocket proteins and E2F4 to a transcriptionally active complex in S-G(2) containing B-Myb. We have studied the function of LINC in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, which are distinguished by a rapid cell cycle resulting from an extremely short G(1) phase. We show that suppressing expression of the LINC component, Lin-9, in F9 cells causes arrest in mitosis, and we have used this system to screen for transcriptional targets. In these cells, B-Myb was found in complexes with Lin-9 and several other LINC constituents, however, the pocket proteins did not associate with LINC unless F9 cells were differentiated. Lin-9 and B-Myb were both required for transcription of G(2)/M genes such as Cyclin B1 and Survivin. Moreover, B-Myb was demonstrated to recruit Lin-9 to the Survivin promoter through multiple Myb-binding sites. The demonstration that a B-Myb/LINC complex is vital for progression through mitosis in cells lacking a G(1)/S checkpoint has implications for both undifferentiated embryonal cells and for cancers in which pocket protein function is compromised.
abstract_ja: 細胞周期遺伝子の転写は、G0-G1期ではp130またはp107ポケットタンパク質およびE2F4と転写抑制複合体を形成し、S-G2期にはB-Mybを含む転写活性複合体へと切り替わるLINCという中核複合体によって制御されることが近年明らかになった。我々は、G1期が極めて短く急速な細胞周期を示すF9胎児性癌細胞におけるLINCの機能を検討した。F9細胞でLINC構成因子であるLin-9の発現を抑制すると有糸分裂停止が生じ、この系を用いて転写標的のスクリーニングを行った。これらの細胞ではB-MybがLin-9や他のLINC構成因子と複合体を形成していたが、ポケットタンパク質は分化させない限りLINCと結合しなかった。Lin-9とB-Mybは、Cyclin B1やSurvivinなどのG2/M期遺伝子の転写に必要であった。さらにB-Mybは、複数のMyb結合部位を介してLin-9をSurvivinプロモーターへリクルートすることが示された。G1/S期チェックポイントを欠く細胞において、B-Myb/LINC複合体が有糸分裂の進行に必須であることは、未分化な胚性細胞、およびポケットタンパク質機能が障害されたがんにとって示唆に富む。
